title: Kamishiro Rui — A Greeting In Return〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I came to see what else SEKAI's new area had to offer...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But it's just so expansive. I've only visited a fraction of it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, there are many places that I'd like to see, so I'll keep exploring for now.
Hi, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Miku, Rin.
I didn't realize you two were also here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup☆ We're here to explore this area as members of the new expedition team♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
New expedition team...?
That sounds like quite a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know, right? We've been doing lots of exploring and talking to all sorts of plushies☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, would it be alright if I joined you two? I'm actually also here to do some exploring.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Of course☆
So, let's GO GO GO♪
Outside the inn

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
A bunch of plushies are gathered over there☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, what a lively sight.
What do you think's going—

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line: Next, we have a new trick for all of you. Watch as we balance on these balls!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, the zombies?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cool! They're doing another performance today☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The zombies told us how they were really happy that they got to do a show with us and make everyone else smile!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And they decided to keep the party going by doing lots of different performances☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is that so?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line:
Alright... Up! We...!
Go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Whoa☆
He's doing a handstand on top of that ball!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cool...! I wanna try doing that too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. It could be fun to do it with them.
So...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why don't we all join in?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alright! Next, I'm gonna do some juggling☆
Check out...this!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
Hey, she's a great juggler!
She's dancing around while... Whoa! She just threw a ball under her legs!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Next up is...Miku the Acrobat☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Here I go, everyone☆
Ready, steady...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Wow! One, two, three... H-How many backflips is she gonna do?!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line: We're just getting started! We're about to do everyone's favorite trick next! Handstands on top of these balls!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
I wanna see you guys do more!
What do you have in store for us next?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all for coming to watch. We actually have balloons for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Wow, this balloon...! It looks just like a rose!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I twisted it into a rose.
I'm glad to see that you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Cool! I didn't know you could turn a balloon into such a pretty rose!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: I want one! I want one too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. I'll make something for each of you.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yay! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. We decided to join in partway through, but it's nice to see that our audience is having so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line: We're just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The zombies also seem to be enjoying themselves.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you for letting us join you guys☆
That was really fun♪

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
We also had a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: On top of that, fewer plushies feel scared of us since we started putting on these performances.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah, and we have you guys to thank for that. We wouldn't have been able to become friends with them otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Also, we should do another show together sometime!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Anyway, see you later.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe! It was so great to see the zombies and other plushies smiling and laughing together☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm so glad to see that they've managed to become friends with everyone in this city.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! It's a good thing that you asked them to do that show♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, the zombies all seem to be having so much fun now☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, good thing we did.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I guess I really do want to bring people together...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Through shows that transcend borders.)
